settings.hbie.desc: Two thresholds decide how a fingerprint pair is concluded. Matching engine score scale: 0 – {max}.
settings.hbie.err.keep: The minimum score must be an integer from 0 up to the conclusion threshold ({max}). Above it, no pair can ever land in review.
settings.hbie.err.match: The conclusion threshold must be an integer from 1 to {max}.
settings.hbie.keep_score.desc: Pairs scoring below this are dropped during matching and never stored as a result.
settings.hbie.keep_score.label: Minimum score to keep
settings.hbie.match_threshold.desc: A score at or above this is concluded as a match; below it goes to review. Lowering it catches more suspects but raises the chance of a false identification.
settings.hbie.match_threshold.label: Match conclusion threshold
settings.hbie.note: Changing the conclusion threshold relabels results already stored. Raising the minimum score does NOT drop low-scoring pairs saved earlier — go to the Crime-scene traces page and run Re-analyze.
settings.hbie.saved_reclassified: Saved. Relabelled {p} result pairs and {n} traces under the new threshold.
settings.hbie.saved_rematch: The minimum score changed: pairs the old level dropped will not reappear on their own. Go to the Crime-scene traces page and run Re-analyze.
settings.hbie.title: Crime-scene trace matching
settings.hbie.warn_low: Threshold {v} is below the level the HBIE documentation recommends: more pairs will be concluded as matches, so review them carefully before using them as evidence.
